# Public captured-text calibration rationale

Two invented public regional implementations share meaningful file paths and
symbols. Questions ask which binding+file implements a specific body fact.
Gold regions are balanced east6/west6 prospectively; there was no retrieval.
Both regions are visible to native/FTS/v2 with equivalent budgets. Same-metadata
distractors are explicit, so the file-level answer needs body inspection.
The 12 body intents have 12 distinct binding+file golds; the delivery test path
is shared by two intents whose gold bindings differ. Report this path coupling;
do not claim independent random samples. Metadata anchors are a separate stratum.
Controls preserve absence ambiguity privacy and unsupported capability semantics.
All code and test text is static fixture data; none is imported or executed.
Original classes and held-outs remain opaque and immutable. No model, study,
ranking, tokenizer result, scientific threshold or usefulness acceptance exists.
